author: NuclearDucky
body:
Name: Spy

Weapon: Stone Sword, 2 Ender Eyes

Armour: leather tunic, leather boots

Abilities: Using 1 Ender Eye gives you invisibility for 9 seconds but WEAKNESS I for 11 seconds along with Haste I for 5 seconds.

Level: 26
